engineering-code-reviewer.use: Review a change for correctness, security, maintainability and test coverage.
engineering-code-reviewer.output: Prioritized findings with file references, impact and suggested fixes.
engineering-code-reviewer.example: Review this change for correctness and missing regression coverage. Cite file locations and explain each finding.

engineering-backend-architect.use: Assess API, data and execution boundaries for a HARQIS integration.
engineering-backend-architect.output: Architecture tradeoffs, interface contracts, failure behavior and validation plan.
engineering-backend-architect.example: Assess this integration against existing apps and workflows. Explain execution ownership, retries and idempotency.

engineering-technical-writer.use: Explain behavior and keep documentation aligned with implementation.
engineering-technical-writer.output: Clear documentation supported by code evidence and verified examples.
engineering-technical-writer.example: Review this documentation against the implementation. Correct drift and explain the user flow.
